parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.lead: State an experimental phenomenon that provides evidence for:
parts.text: the particle nature of electromagnetic radiation.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead: A particle of matter moves with momentum *p*.
parts.text: State the equation that gives the effective wavelength *λ* of the particle. State the name of any other symbols used.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the name given to the wavelength of the moving particle.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.lead: Electrons are accelerated from rest through a potential difference (p.d.) of 4.8 kV.
parts.text: Show that the final speed of the electrons is 4.1 × 10⁷ m s⁻¹.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the effective wavelength of a beam of electrons moving at the speed in (c)(i).
